name: Unidentified Galactic Empire starship
description: A starship served within the navy of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, a member of the Empire who served as a mole for the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn sabotaged the ship's reactor, trapping seventeen engineers aboard. Imperial officer Lieutenant Beilert Valance later rescued the engineers but suffered radiation burns as a result.
